raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

**Draft, stacked on [#60683](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60683) at its head `df3693c8f8`.** Only the top 3
commits belong to this PR; everything below them is #60683. **This PR's changes alone:
[df3693c8f8...kimik3/stack-plain-k2](https://github.com/amd-mghanimi/vllm/compare/df3693c8f8...kimik3/stack-plain-k2)**
(3 commits, 21 files). It puts the mono MoE launch of
[#60793](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60793) on top of #60683's mono decode for Kimi-K3 on MI355X (gfx950),
and adds K2 in plain decode steps so the two work together. The 3 commits:

1. Mono MoE: one launch for a decode MoE layer of up to 32 rows (from #60793).
2. Mono MoE: numerics and path-selection tests (from #60793).
3. Mono decode: K2 in plain decode steps.

**K2 in plain decode steps.** #60683 runs K2 (o_proj, its all-reduce, the MLP AttnRes and the latent MoE) only on
speculative-verify steps. K2 does not depend on how o_proj's input was made, so KDA layers now run vLLM's AttnRes and
KDA up to o_proj's input (`KimiK3DeltaAttention.forward_core`), then K2, as MLA layers already do. A plain decode step
of at most 8 rows takes this path.

**Rebased on #60683 `df3693c8f8` (Oct 16).** The previous head (`4929a0ada8`, on #60683 `a717180301`) had a 4th commit
that merged the mono widths into the resolved CUDA graph sizes. `df3693c8f8` fixes the same capture-size issue in
#60683, so that commit is dropped. The mono MoE now also runs on AITER v0.1.25 and later, which removed
`communication_ops_utils.traced` (ROCm/aiter#6377) and `compile_gemm2_a4w4_port(g2_kstatic=)`. The device helpers use
a local `traced` (`ASTRewriter.transform`, as #60683's own helpers do) and their own `!llvm.ptr` casts, and
`g2_kstatic=True` is passed only where AITER still takes it (v0.1.24.post1, which vLLM's ROCm base image pins). **All
results below were measured at the previous head, on AITER v0.1.24; the current head has not been re-measured yet.**

Steps above 8 rows keep vLLM's layers, with the mono MoE launch (up to 32 rows) for the MoE. Switches: `--monokernel`
(#60683's mono decode, now with plain decode) and `VLLM_ROCM_MONO_MOE=1` (mono MoE), each usable alone.

## Claims

- Speculative decoding (DSpark), 9 to 32 rows per step: as fast as #60683 or faster, never slower beyond noise.
  Measured at the previous head, k = 3: 12 rows -5.7%, 16 rows -4.9%, 20 to 32 rows within 1%. Repeated on the earlier
  base with k = 3 and k = 7: 12 rows -5.7%, 16 rows -2.5% (k = 3) and -5.0% (k = 7), 32 rows 0% (k = 3) and -3.0% (k = 7).
- Speculative decoding, up to 8 rows per step: the same as #60683 (both run #60683's K2).
- Plain decode, 1 to 8 rows per step: median TPOT 1.19x to 1.38x better than stock, measured at the previous head. 12 and 16
  rows: 2% to 3% better; 24 and 32 rows: 0.3% to 0.9% slower than stock, in both runs. #60683 alone refuses plain
  decode.
- Every decode step of at most 8 rows runs #60683's K2 (60,698 of 60,698 counted at the previous head, below), so the
  mono MoE launch only serves steps above 8 rows.

## Validation

`moonshotai/Kimi-K3`, TP8, MI355X, MI355X OOB serving settings, 8k input / 1k output, median TPOT in ms. A step
carries `concurrency` rows in plain decode and `concurrency x (k + 1)` rows with DSpark (TRITON_MLA drafter). Every
request succeeded and no server logged a memory access fault. Negative is faster. Each table compares builds on one
node only.

### At the previous head (`4929a0ada8`, on #60683 `a717180301`)

Both builds on one node, 2 runs per cell (TPOT is the mean of the two). Image: vLLM nightly `5555a2d8` (main
`c077dc663d`, #60683's base, plus 6 commits without compiled-code changes; AITER v0.1.24), with each tree's `vllm/`
Python on top, so the builds run exactly #60683 at `a717180301` and this PR at that head over the same compiled base.
Both use `--monokernel`; this PR adds `VLLM_ROCM_MONO_MOE=1`. #60683 gets an explicit CUDA graph size list (its
capture-size issue, since fixed in #60683 by `df3693c8f8`).

| Rows per step | Decode | #60683 | This PR | This PR vs #60683 |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 4 | DSpark k=3, c1 | 3.46 | 3.46 | 0% |
| 8 | DSpark k=3, c2 | 4.43 | 4.42 | 0% |
| 12 | DSpark k=3, c3 | 6.83 | 6.44 | -5.7% |
| 16 | DSpark k=3, c4 | 7.15 | 6.80 | -4.9% |
| 20 | DSpark k=3, c5 | 8.27 | 8.18 | -1.0% |
| 24 | DSpark k=3, c6 | 8.42 | 8.39 | -0.4% |
| 32 | DSpark k=3, c8 | 9.79 | 9.82 | +0.3% |
| 8 | DSpark k=7, c1 | 2.10 | 2.10 | 0% |
| 16 | DSpark k=7, c2 | 3.57 | 3.45 | -3.4% |
| 24 | DSpark k=7, c3 | 4.22 | 4.18 | -0.9% |
| 32 | DSpark k=7, c4 | 4.75 | 4.73 | -0.3% (within run-to-run spread: #60683 4.58 and 4.91) |
| 4 | DSpark k=1, c2 | 7.10 | 7.09 | 0% |
| 8 | DSpark k=1, c4 | 9.26 | 9.27 | 0% |
| 12 | DSpark k=1, c6 | 14.08 | 13.28 | -5.6% |
| 16 | DSpark k=1, c8 | 14.54 | 14.10 | -3.1% |
| 24 | DSpark k=1, c12 | 17.37 | 17.32 | -0.3% |
| 32 | DSpark k=1, c16 | 19.76 | 19.82 | +0.3% |

The two runs per cell: 16 rows -6.5% and -3.3%; 12 rows -5.7% and -5.7%. Output throughput at 12 rows: 431 and 433
tok/s against 408 and 410.

Plain decode against stock (main `c077dc663d`, same image base), same node, 2 runs per cell:

| Rows per step | Decode | Stock | This PR | This PR vs stock | Both runs |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | plain, c1 | 14.30 | 10.90 | -23.8% (1.31x) | faster |
| 2 | plain, c2 | 15.00 | 11.89 | -20.7% (1.26x) | faster |
| 4 | plain, c4 | 19.11 | 13.85 | -27.5% (1.38x) | faster |
| 8 | plain, c8 | 20.90 | 17.52 | -16.2% (1.19x) | faster |
| 12 | plain, c12 | 25.76 | 25.02 | -2.9% | faster |
| 16 | plain, c16 | 27.14 | 26.60 | -2.0% | faster |
| 24 | plain, c24 | 32.45 | 32.56 | +0.3% | slower (+0.4%, +0.3%) |
| 32 | plain, c32 | 37.03 | 37.36 | +0.9% | slower (+0.9%, +0.9%) |

### Repeated runs on the earlier base

The same 4 changes on #60683 at `0917105f18` (switch `VLLM_ROCM_MONO_DECODE=1` there), vLLM nightly `81198e97` with each
build's changes on top, one node, 3 runs per cell, median of the three.

| Rows per step | Decode | #60683 | This PR | This PR vs #60683 | Runs where this PR is faster |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 8 | DSpark k=3, c2 | 4.41 | 4.41 | 0% | |
| 12 | DSpark k=3, c3 | 6.85 | 6.46 | -5.7% | 3 of 3 (ranges 6.83-6.89 vs 6.43-6.46) |
| 16 | DSpark k=3, c4 | 7.13 | 6.95 | -2.5% | 3 of 3 |
| 20 | DSpark k=3, c5 | 8.27 | 8.23 | -0.5% | 3 of 3 |
| 24 | DSpark k=3, c6 | 8.48 | 8.43 | -0.6% | 2 of 3 |
| 32 | DSpark k=3, c8 | 9.79 | 9.79 | 0% | 2 of 3 |
| 8 | DSpark k=7, c1 | 2.11 | 2.12 | 0% | |
| 16 | DSpark k=7, c2 | 3.58 | 3.40 | -5.0% | 3 of 3 |
| 24 | DSpark k=7, c3 | 4.22 | 4.22 | 0% | 2 of 3 |
| 32 | DSpark k=7, c4 | 4.96 | 4.81 | -3.0% | 3 of 3 |
| 8 | DSpark k=1, c4 | 9.31 | 9.29 | 0% | |
| 12 | DSpark k=1, c6 | 14.18 | 13.36 | -5.8% | 3 of 3 |
| 16 | DSpark k=1, c8 | 14.58 | 14.13 | -3.1% | 3 of 3 |
| 20 | DSpark k=1, c10 | 17.25 | 16.85 | -2.3% | 3 of 3 |
| 24 | DSpark k=1, c12 | 17.44 | 17.43 | 0% | 2 of 3 |
| 32 | DSpark k=1, c16 | 19.94 | 20.05 | +0.6% | 0 of 3 |

Plain decode on the earlier base gave the same picture (3 runs per cell, median, stock is the same nightly): 1.38x at
4 rows, 1.20x at 8, -3.0% at 12, -2.6% at 16, +0.2% at 24 and +1.0% at 32 (slower in all 3 runs at 24 and 32).

#60683 alone does not start without speculative decoding. Above 8 rows, #60683's MoE cannot run unchanged (its rows
are held in LDS); an earlier #60683 version's standalone MoE launch, chunked into 8-row launches, was 8% to 39% slower
than stock at 12 to 32 plain rows, so this PR uses #60683's MoE (inside K2) up to 8 rows and the mono MoE above.

### Which path steps of at most 8 rows take

Steps of at most 8 rows that K2 declines would fall to the mono MoE instead of #60683's MoE. Counted at the previous head with
vLLM's `monokernel_steps` counter, labelled per step with the graph mode and the row count (a measurement-only copy of
`routing.py`), on this PR's server: 8k / 1k at c1 to c8 plus short requests (256 in / 128 out, 64 requests per
concurrency, frequent arrivals).

| Decode | Steps of at most 8 rows | of which K2 | Steps above 8 rows (K2 declines: width) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| DSpark k=3 | 9,537 | 9,537 | 4,509 full graph, 244 piecewise, 137 eager |
| plain | 51,161 | 51,161 | 250 piecewise, 137 eager |

Every step of at most 8 rows ran K2; the only declined steps had more than 8 rows (prefill and mixed steps, and
speculative steps above K2's widths, which take the mono MoE). The earlier base gave the same counts.

### Tests and accuracy

- At the previous head on MI355X: this PR's mono MoE numerics and gate tests 27 passed; #60683's mono tests 49 passed (44 on
  #60683's own tree; the 5 more are this PR's plain-decode cases in `test_spec.py`); #60683's 8-GPU numerics passed on
  both trees.
- GPQA Diamond (198 questions, no thinking, 4k tokens, greedy) at the previous head: 0.803 with DSpark k = 3, 0.773 in plain
  decode (before the rebase: 0.798 and 0.778; one question is 0.005).

## Details

- The mono MoE commits are #60793's eleven, squashed into the kernel and its tests and moved beside #60683's
  `vllm/models/kimi_k3/amd/mono/` (as `mono_moe/`); #60793 itself stays based on main. Its switch is
  `VLLM_ROCM_MONO_MOE` because `--monokernel` turns on the mono decode, which refuses at startup the configs it does not
  serve (TP other than 8, more than 7 speculative tokens, Model Runner V1, piecewise-only graphs); the mono MoE checks
  each layer on its first forward instead and falls back to the multi-kernel path where the launch does not fit.
- On the rebase, `VLLM_ROCM_MONO_DECODE` and the fault-injection variables, which #60683 removed, were dropped from
  `vllm/envs.py`.

---

- [ ] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [ ] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The MonoKernel test kit (RFC #60904): fake configs, a fake spec and kernel,
+a golden-layer checker and a fault harness, for any model's MonoSpec tests."""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.models.common.mono.spec import Feature, MonoSpec, MonoStep
+
+
+def fake_vllm_config(**over) -> SimpleNamespace:
+    """A supported TP8 FULL-graph config with speculative decoding; ``over``
+    sets dotted paths, e.g. ``{"parallel_config.data_parallel_size": 2}``."""
+    c = SimpleNamespace(
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            tensor_parallel_size=8,
+            pipeline_parallel_size=1,
+            data_parallel_size=1,
+            enable_expert_parallel=False,
+            enable_eplb=False,
+            decode_context_parallel_size=1,
+            prefill_context_parallel_size=1,
+        ),
+        lora_config=None,
+        kv_transfer_config=None,
+        aux_output_config=SimpleNamespace(enable_return_routed_experts=False),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(enable_sleep_mode=False),
+        offload_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            uva=SimpleNamespace(cpu_offload_gb=0),
+            prefetch=SimpleNamespace(offload_group_size=0),
+        ),
+        weight_transfer_config=None,
+        use_v2_model_runner=True,
+        speculative_config=SimpleNamespace(num_speculative_tokens=3),
+        kernel_config=SimpleNamespace(monokernel=True),
+        compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE,
+            cudagraph_capture_sizes=list(range(1, 17)),
+            static_forward_context={},
+        ),
+    )
+    for path, v in over.items():
+        obj = c
+        *head, last = path.split(".")
+        for h in head:
+            obj = getattr(obj, h)
+        setattr(obj, last, v)
+    return c
+
+
+class FakeKernel:
+    """A layer kernel that adds 1 to the hidden states and reports ``words``."""
+
+    def __init__(self, layer: int, width: int, words: torch.Tensor, caches: bool):
+        self.layer, self.width, self.words = layer, width, words
+        self.cache_layers = (f"layers.{layer}.attn",) if caches else ()
+        self.compiled: list[Any] = []
+
+    def launch(self, step: MonoStep, positions, hidden_states, residual):
+        return hidden_states + 1, residual
+
+    def health(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.words
+
+    def warmup_keys(self) -> list[Any]:
+        return [("fake", self.width)]
+
+    def compile(self, key: Any) -> None:
+        self.compiled.append(key)
+
+
+def fake_spec(
+    *,
+    layers: list[int] | None = None,
+    widths: tuple[int, ...] = (4, 8),
+    supports: frozenset[Feature] = frozenset({Feature.SPECULATIVE_DECODING}),
+    refuse_config: Callable[[Any], list[str]] = lambda c: [],
+    refuse_model: Callable[[Any], list[str]] = lambda m: [],
+    bind: Callable[[Any, Any], list[str]] = lambda ctx, caches: [],
+    eligible: Callable[[Any, MonoStep], str | None] = lambda ctx, step: None,
+    words: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    caches: bool = False,
+) -> MonoSpec:
+    """``caches``: every kernel checks its layer's cache, ``layers.<i>.attn``."""
+    health = torch.zeros(8, dtype=torch.int32) if words is None else words
+    return MonoSpec(
+        name="fake",
+        layers=lambda config: [1, 2] if layers is None else layers,
+        widths=lambda vllm_config: widths,
+        supports=supports,
+        caches={},
+        weight_source="views",
+        options={},
+        refuse_config=refuse_config,
+        refuse_model=refuse_model,
+        pack=lambda model, ctx: None,
+        bind=bind,
+        eligible=eligible,
+        build=lambda ctx, packed, layer, width: FakeKernel(
+            layer.layer_idx, width, health, caches
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def assert_matches_layer(
+    kernel_out: torch.Tensor, layer_out: torch.Tensor, cos_min: float = 0.9999
+) -> None:
+    """The golden-layer check: a layer kernel's output against the vLLM layer's
+    on the same inputs (cosine, so it holds across reduction orders)."""
+    a, b = kernel_out.float().reshape(-1), layer_out.float().reshape(-1)
+    cos = F.cosine_similarity(a, b, dim=0).item()
+    assert cos > cos_min, f"cosine {cos} <= {cos_min}"
+
+
+def failed_words(tp: int, ranks: list[int]) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The fault harness: the output rank's flags after ``ranks`` gave up."""
+    words = torch.zeros(tp, dtype=torch.int32)
+    words[ranks] = 1
+    return words

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The MonoKernel library on CPU, with a fake spec and kernel: refusals, the
+capture sizes, routing, cache re-binding, parameter names, fail-stop, the
+counters and the JIT warm-up."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from tests.models.common.mono.kit import (
+    FakeKernel,
+    failed_words,
+    fake_spec,
+    fake_vllm_config,
+)
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.models.common.mono import failstop, guards, layer, routing
+from vllm.models.common.mono.spec import Feature, MonoStep, MonoUnsupported
+
+
+class _Layer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, i: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.layer_idx = i
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.full((4,), float(i)))
+
+    def forward(self, positions, hidden_states, residual):
+        return hidden_states - 1, residual
+
+
+class _Model(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, n: int = 4):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(_Layer(i) for i in range(n))
+        self.start_layer, self.end_layer = 0, n
+        self.config = SimpleNamespace()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def one_rank(monkeypatch):
+    """A single-rank TP group: TP agreement is a no-op."""
+    import vllm.distributed
+
+    tp = SimpleNamespace(rank_in_group=0, cpu_group=None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(vllm.distributed, "get_tp_group", lambda: tp)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "all_reduce", lambda *a, **k: None)
+    failstop.STEPS.clear()
+    failstop.INCIDENTS.clear()
+
+
+def _forward_context(monkeypatch, mode="FULL", md=None):
+    fc = SimpleNamespace(
+        cudagraph_runtime_mode=getattr(CUDAGraphMode, mode),
+        attn_metadata={} if md is None else md,
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(routing, "get_forward_context", lambda: fc)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(layer, "get_forward_context", lambda: fc)
+    return fc
+
+
+def _mono(spec=None, model=None, **cfg):
+    return routing.Mono(spec or fake_spec(), model or _Model(), fake_vllm_config(**cfg))
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- refusals
+
+
+def test_supported_config_is_accepted():
+    assert guards.refuse_config(fake_spec(), fake_vllm_config()) == []
+
+
+def test_every_refusal_is_reported_at_once():
+    spec = fake_spec(refuse_config=lambda c: ["spec's own"])
+    reasons = guards.refuse_config(
+        spec,
+        fake_vllm_config(
+            **{
+                "parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size": 2,
+                "parallel_config.data_parallel_size": 2,
+                "parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel": True,
+                "parallel_config.enable_eplb": True,
+                "parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size": 2,
+                "parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size": 2,
+                "lora_config": object(),
+                "kv_transfer_config": object(),
+                "aux_output_config.enable_return_routed_experts": True,
+                "model_config.enable_sleep_mode": True,
+                "offload_config.uva.cpu_offload_gb": 1,
+                "weight_transfer_config": object(),
+                "use_v2_model_runner": False,
+                "compilation_config.cudagraph_mode": CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE,
+            }
+        ),
+    )
+    # 12 unsupported features, the runner, the graph mode, the spec's own
+    assert len(reasons) == 15, reasons
+    assert reasons[-1] == "spec's own"
+
+
+def test_a_supported_feature_is_not_refused():
+    spec = fake_spec(
+        supports=frozenset({Feature.SPECULATIVE_DECODING, Feature.DATA_PARALLEL})
+    )
+    cfg = fake_vllm_config(**{"parallel_config.data_parallel_size": 2})
+    assert guards.refuse_config(spec, cfg) == []
+
+
+def test_configure_raises_with_every_reason(monkeypatch):
+    spec = fake_spec(refuse_config=lambda c: ["a", "b"])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(guards, "load_spec", lambda path: spec)
+    with pytest.raises(MonoUnsupported, match="a; b"):
+        guards.configure(fake_vllm_config(), "x:SPEC")
+
+
+def test_capture_sizes_up_to_the_widest_are_the_widths(monkeypatch):
+    """Applied to vLLM's final sizes (defaults included); larger sizes stay."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(guards, "load_spec", lambda path: fake_spec())
+    default = [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32]
+    sizes = guards.capture_sizes("x:SPEC", fake_vllm_config(), default)
+    assert sizes == [4, 8, 16, 24, 32]
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- routing
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "mode, tokens, eligible, why",
+    [
+        ("FULL", 4, None, None),
+        ("NONE", 8, None, None),
+        ("PIECEWISE", 4, None, "piecewise"),
+        ("FULL", 6, None, "width"),
+        ("NONE", 4, "not pure decode", "not pure decode"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_routing_runs_pure_decode_widths_only(
+    monkeypatch, one_rank, mode, tokens, eligible, why
+):
+    _forward_context(monkeypatch, mode)
+    mono = _mono(fake_spec(eligible=lambda ctx, step: eligible))
+    assert mono.begin_step(torch.zeros(tokens)) == why
+    assert (mono.step is None) == (why is not None)
+
+
+def test_every_rank_decides_alike(monkeypatch, one_rank):
+    """The decision reads only the batch and the attention metadata."""
+    md = {"attn": SimpleNamespace(num_prefills=0)}
+    _forward_context(monkeypatch, "FULL", md)
+    spec = fake_spec(
+        eligible=lambda ctx, step: (
+            "prefill" if step.attn_metadata["attn"].num_prefills else None
+        )
+    )
+    ranks = [_mono(spec) for _ in range(8)]
+    for n in (4, 6, 8):
+        assert len({m.begin_step(torch.zeros(n)) for m in ranks}) == 1
+
+
+def test_forward_layer_decides_once_a_forward(monkeypatch, one_rank):
+    fc = _forward_context(monkeypatch, "FULL")
+    calls: list[MonoStep] = []
+
+    def eligible(ctx, step):
+        calls.append(step)
+        return None
+
+    spec = fake_spec(eligible=eligible)
+    model = _Model()
+    mono = _mono(spec, model)
+    h, r = torch.zeros(4), torch.zeros(4)
+    pos = torch.zeros(4)
+    out = [
+        layer.forward_layer(mono, i, model.layers[i], pos, h, r)[0] for i in range(4)
+    ]
+    assert len(calls) == 1
+    # layers 1, 2 have kernels (+1), layers 0, 3 run vLLM's (-1)
+    assert [o[0].item() for o in out] == [-1.0, 1.0, 1.0, -1.0]
+    fc2 = SimpleNamespace(**vars(fc))  # a new forward decides again
+    monkeypatch.setattr(layer, "get_forward_context", lambda: fc2)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(routing, "get_forward_context", lambda: fc2)
+    layer.forward_layer(mono, 1, model.layers[1], pos, h, r)
+    assert len(calls) == 2
+
+
+def test_caches_are_rebound_when_they_move(monkeypatch, one_rank):
+    _forward_context(monkeypatch, "FULL")
+    binds: list[dict] = []
+
+    def bind(ctx, caches):
+        binds.append(caches)
+        return []
+
+    spec = fake_spec(bind=bind, caches=True)
+    mono = _mono(spec)
+    sfc = mono.ctx.vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+    for i in (1, 2):
+        sfc[f"layers.{i}.attn"] = SimpleNamespace(kv_cache=torch.zeros(4))
+    mono.begin_step(torch.zeros(4))
+    mono.begin_step(torch.zeros(4))
+    assert len(binds) == 1
+    sfc["layers.1.attn"].kv_cache = torch.zeros(8)  # a profiling cache replaced
+    mono.begin_step(torch.zeros(4))
+    assert len(binds) == 2
+
+
+def test_a_cache_refusal_raises(monkeypatch, one_rank):
+    _forward_context(monkeypatch, "FULL")
+    mono = _mono(fake_spec(bind=lambda ctx, caches: ["bad layout"], caches=True))
+    sfc = mono.ctx.vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+    for i in (1, 2):
+        sfc[f"layers.{i}.attn"] = SimpleNamespace(kv_cache=torch.zeros(4))
+    with pytest.raises(MonoUnsupported, match="bad layout"):
+        mono.begin_step(torch.zeros(4))
+
+
+def test_a_model_refusal_raises(one_rank):
+    with pytest.raises(MonoUnsupported, match="views"):
+        _mono(fake_spec(refuse_model=lambda m: ["views"]))
+
+
+def test_parameter_names_and_values_do_not_change(monkeypatch, one_rank):
+    """Attach leaves the module tree, names and loaded values untouched."""
+    model = _Model()
+    before = {k: v.clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
+    monkeypatch.setattr(layer, "load_spec", lambda path: fake_spec())
+    cfg = fake_vllm_config()
+    model.mono = layer.attach(model, cfg, "x:SPEC")
+    assert model.mono is not None
+    after = model.state_dict()
+    assert list(after) == list(before)
+    assert all(torch.equal(after[k], v) for k, v in before.items())
+    cfg.kernel_config.monokernel = False
+    assert layer.attach(_Model(), cfg, "x:SPEC") is None
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- fail-stop
+
+
+def test_a_failed_step_raises():
+    failstop.check(failed_words(8, []))
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match=r"TP ranks \[3\]"):
+        failstop.check(failed_words(8, [3]))
+
+
+def test_a_failed_step_is_counted_by_rank():
+    failstop.INCIDENTS.clear()
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        failstop.check(failed_words(8, [2, 5]))
+    assert failstop.drain() == {"incidents:2": 1, "incidents:5": 1}
+
+
+def test_steps_are_counted_by_path(monkeypatch, one_rank):
+    """A FULL replay runs no Python: its step counts the decision its graph
+    baked in at capture."""
+    _forward_context(monkeypatch, "FULL")
+    mono = _mono(fake_spec(eligible=lambda ctx, step: None))
+    mono.begin_step(torch.zeros(4))  # captured: mono
+    mono.begin_step(torch.zeros(6))  # captured: width
+    mono.account(4, CUDAGraphMode.FULL)
+    mono.account(4, CUDAGraphMode.FULL)
+    mono.account(6, CUDAGraphMode.FULL)
+    _forward_context(monkeypatch, "NONE")
+    mono.begin_step(torch.zeros(5))
+    mono.account(5, CUDAGraphMode.NONE)
+    assert failstop.drain() == {
+        "steps:fake:mono": 2,
+        "steps:fake:width": 2,
+    }
+    assert failstop.drain() is None
+
+
+def test_a_capture_bakes_its_decision_in_any_runtime_mode(monkeypatch, one_rank):
+    """Model Runner V2 captures FULL graphs with the runtime mode NONE."""
+    _forward_context(monkeypatch, "NONE")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "is_current_stream_capturing", lambda: True)
+    mono = _mono(fake_spec(eligible=lambda ctx, step: None))
+    mono.begin_step(torch.zeros(4))
+    mono.account(4, CUDAGraphMode.FULL)
+    assert failstop.drain() == {"steps:fake:mono": 1}
+
+
+def test_every_width_is_registered_for_jit_warmup(monkeypatch, one_rank):
+    registered = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        routing.MonoWarmup, "register_warmup", lambda self: registered.append(self)
+    )
+    mono = _mono()
+    (warmup,) = registered
+    warmup.warmup()
+    compiled = {k for kern in mono.kernels.values() for k in kern.compiled}
+    assert compiled == {("fake", 4), ("fake", 8)}
+
+
+def test_fake_kernel_health_reaches_the_runner(one_rank):
+    words = failed_words(8, [1])
+    mono = _mono(fake_spec(words=words))
+    assert isinstance(next(iter(mono.kernels.values())), FakeKernel)
+    assert layer.health(mono) is words
+    assert layer.health(None) is None
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        failstop.check(layer.health(mono))

+"""Fail-stop end to end: a TP rank that stalls inside a served Kimi-K3
+MonoKernel step fails that step, and the engine stops instead of hanging or
+returning the step's tokens."""
+
+import json
+import os
+import time
+
+import pytest
+import requests
+
+from tests.models.kimi_k3.amd_mono.test_numerics import needs_gfx950
+from tests.utils import RemoteOpenAIServer, multi_gpu_test
+
+MODEL = "riverclouds/Kimi-K3-8L-dummy"
+DRAFT = "riverclouds/Kimi-K3-DSpark-for-8L-dummy"
+STALLED = 3
+FAULT_EPOCH = 256  # a mono decode step well past warm-up and capture
+STARTUP_TIMEOUT = 1800
+FAULT_DEADLINE = 900
+EXIT_TIMEOUT = 300
+
+# Builds every rank's K2 with the fault hook (``K2Build.fault_*``): CTA 0 of
+# rank STALLED stalls past every in-kernel wait's bound in the step at
+# FAULT_EPOCH. Patched into ``MONO_SPEC.pack`` as the spec module loads, in
+# every vLLM process.
+_SITECUSTOMIZE = """\
+import dataclasses
+import importlib.abc
+import importlib.machinery
+import sys
+
+_MODULE = "vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.spec"
+
+
+def _patch(module):
+    pack = module.MONO_SPEC.pack
+
+    def faulty_pack(model, ctx):
+        runner = pack(model, ctx)
+        runner.fault = {{
+            "fault_rank": {rank},
+            "fault_epoch": {epoch},
+            "fault_layer": 128 + runner.first_layer,  # the step's first K2
+            "fault_ticks": {ticks},
+        }}
+        return runner
+
+    module.MONO_SPEC = dataclasses.replace(module.MONO_SPEC, pack=faulty_pack)
+
+
+class _Finder(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
+    def find_spec(self, name, path, target=None):
+        if name != _MODULE:
+            return None
+        spec = importlib.machinery.PathFinder.find_spec(name, path)
+        exec_module = spec.loader.exec_module
+
+        def patched_exec(module):
+            exec_module(module)
+            _patch(module)
+
+        spec.loader.exec_module = patched_exec
+        return spec
+
+
+sys.meta_path.insert(0, _Finder())
+"""
+
+SERVER_ARGS = [
+    "--trust-remote-code",
+    "--language-model-only",
+    "--load-format",
+    "dummy",
+    "--tensor-parallel-size",
+    "8",
+    "--decode-context-parallel-size",
+    "8",
+    "--dcp-comm-backend",
+    "a2a",
+    "--kv-cache-dtype",
+    "fp8",
+    "--max-model-len",
+    "8192",
+    "--max-num-seqs",
+    "2",
+    "--attention-config",
+    json.dumps({"mla_prefill_backend": "ROCM_AITER_FA"}),
+    "--speculative-config",
+    json.dumps(
+        {

+"""Kimi-K3's MonoKernels on MI355X against the ops vLLM runs for the same
+spec-verify step, random weights in the checkpoint's formats at TP8 shapes:
+
+- K1 (one GPU): AttnRes -> in_proj -> f_b -> conv -> KDA recurrence -> gated
+  norm, the conv / SSM state updates and a block-write layer's block store.
+- K2 (eight GPUs): o_proj + all-reduce + the MLP AttnRes + the latent MoE. The
+  MoE is compared on the kernel's own MLP input, where routing cannot differ.
+  Then a CUDA graph of K2 replayed 300 times, bit-identical, and a stalled rank
+  (the fault hook): every rank's launch finishes and the output rank's flags
+  fail the step.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import ray
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from einops import rearrange
+
+from tests.utils import (
+    init_test_distributed_environment,
+    multi_gpu_test,
+    multi_process_parallel,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+bf = torch.bfloat16
+COS_MIN = 0.9999
+
+
+def _on_gfx950() -> bool:
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    return on_gfx950()
+
+
+needs_gfx950 = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _on_gfx950(), reason="the K3 mono kernels need gfx950 (MI355X)"
+)
+
+
+def _cos(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    a, b = a.float().reshape(-1), b.float().reshape(-1)
+    return F.cosine_similarity(a, b, dim=0).item()
+
+
+def _rel_l2(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    a, b = a.float(), b.float()
+    return ((a - b).norm() / b.norm()).item()
+
+
+def _randn(g, *shape, scale=1.0, dtype=bf):
+    return (torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, device=g.device) * scale).to(dtype)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- K1
+
+
+def _kda_inputs(nb: int, nacc: int, dim_first: bool, S: int, slots: int = 16):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono.attention.kda import (
+        HD,
+        HIDDEN,
+        NH,
+        NPROJ,
+        PROJ,
+        QKV,
+    )
+
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+    sl = 3 + (S - 1)
+    w = {
+        "prefix": _randn(g, S, HIDDEN, scale=2.0),
+        "delta": _randn(g, S, HIDDEN, scale=0.5),
+        "blocks": _randn(g, S, 8, HIDDEN, scale=2.0),
+        "ares_nw": (1 + _randn(g, HIDDEN, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+        "ares_qk": _randn(g, HIDDEN, scale=0.05),
+        "in_nw": (1 + _randn(g, HIDDEN, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+        "w_in": _randn(g, NPROJ, HIDDEN, scale=0.02),
+        "w_fb": _randn(g, PROJ, HD, scale=0.08),
+        "conv_w": _randn(g, QKV, 4, scale=0.4, dtype=torch.float32),
+        "a_log": _randn(g, NH, scale=0.5, dtype=torch.float32),
+        "dt_bias": _randn(g, PROJ, scale=0.5, dtype=torch.float32),
+        "on_w": (1 + _randn(g, HD, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+    }
+    w["w_in"][NPROJ - 4 :].zero_()
+    # vLLM packs a layer's conv and SSM state in one padded page: strided slots
+    pad = _randn(g, slots, NH * HD * HD + 24576, scale=0.05, dtype=torch.float32)
+    w["rstate"] = pad[:, : NH * HD * HD].view(slots, NH, HD, HD)
+    conv = _randn(g, slots, QKV * sl + 4096)[:, : QKV * sl]
+    if dim_first:
+        w["conv_state"] = conv.view(slots, QKV, sl)
+    else:
+        w["conv_state"] = conv.view(slots, sl, QKV).transpose(-1, -2)
+    w["st_idx"] = torch.arange(3, 3 + S, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(1, S)
+    w["num_acc"] = torch.full((1,), nacc, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    return w
+
+
+def _kda_reference(w, nb: int, S: int, write_idx: int):
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.ops.causal_conv1d import (
+        causal_conv1d_update,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.attn_res import attn_res
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono.attention.kda import HD, NH, PROJ, QKV
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.third_party.kda import fused_recurrent_kda
+    from vllm.third_party.flash_linear_attention.ops.kda import FusedRMSNormGated
+
+    prefix, blocks = w["prefix"].clone(), w["blocks"].clone()
+    x = attn_res(
+        prefix,
+        w["delta"],
+        blocks,
+        w["ares_nw"],
+        w["ares_qk"],
+        w["in_nw"],
+        nb,
+        write_idx,
+        1e-5,
+        1e-5,
+    )
+    proj = F.linear(x, w["w_in"])
+    mixed_qkv, g2, f_a, beta = proj.split([QKV, PROJ, HD, NH + 4], dim=-1)[:4]
+    g1 = F.linear(f_a, w["w_fb"])
+    conv_state, rstate = w["conv_state"].clone(), w["rstate"].clone()
+    qsl = torch.tensor([0, S], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    conv = causal_conv1d_update(
+        mixed_qkv.contiguous(),
+        conv_state,
+        w["conv_w"],
+        None,
+        activation="silu",
+        conv_state_indices=w["st_idx"][:, 0].contiguous(),
+        num_accepted_tokens=w["num_acc"],
+        query_start_loc=qsl,
+        max_query_len=S,
+        validate_data=False,
+        out=torch.empty_like(mixed_qkv),
+    )
+    q, k, v = (
+        rearrange(t, "n (h d) -> 1 n h d", d=HD) for t in conv.split(PROJ, dim=-1)
+    )
+    core = torch.empty(1, S, NH, HD, dtype=bf, device="cuda")
+    fused_recurrent_kda(
+        q=q,
+        k=k,
+        v=v,
+        raw_g=rearrange(g1, "n (h d) -> 1 n h d", d=HD),
+        raw_beta=beta[:, :NH].unsqueeze(0),
+        A_log=w["a_log"],
+        dt_bias=w["dt_bias"],
+        lower_bound=-5.0,
+        initial_state=rstate,
+        cu_seqlens=qsl,
+        ssm_state_indices=w["st_idx"],
+        num_accepted_tokens=w["num_acc"],
+        uniform_sequence_length=S,
+        out=core,
+    )
+    with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig()):
+        norm = FusedRMSNormGated(HD, activation="sigmoid").cuda()
+    norm.weight.data = w["on_w"].clone()
+    out = norm.forward_cuda(core, rearrange(g2, "n (h d) -> 1 n h d", d=HD))
+    return {
+        "prefix": prefix,
+        "blocks": blocks,
+        "conv_state": conv_state,
+        "rstate": rstate,
+        "core": out.reshape(S, PROJ),
+    }
+
+
+@needs_gfx950
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dim_first", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("nacc", [1, 3])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("write", [False, True])
+def test_k1_matches_vllm_ops(dim_first: bool, nacc: int, write: bool) -> None:
+    """K1 against attn_res -> in_proj -> f_b -> causal_conv1d_update ->
+    fused_recurrent_kda -> FusedRMSNormGated on one spec-verify step (one
+    request, 8 tokens), including the state each step leaves behind."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono.attention.kda import (
+        PROJ,
+        KdaPreBuild,
+        kda_pre,
+        scratch_bytes,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono.common.plan import HEALTH_WORDS
+
+    S, nb = 8, 4
+    # a block-write layer appends block nb (block_write_idx == prev_valid_blocks)
+    write_idx = nb if write else -1
+    w = _kda_inputs(nb, nacc, dim_first, S)
+    ref = _kda_reference(w, nb, S, write_idx)
+
+    key = KdaPreBuild(
+        tokens=S,
+        qlen=S,
+        nblocks=nb,
+        delta=True,
+        state_len=w["conv_state"].size(-1),
+        write_idx=write_idx,
+    )
+    prefix, blocks = w["prefix"].clone(), w["blocks"].clone()
+    conv_state, rstate = w["conv_state"].clone(), w["rstate"].clone()
+    core = torch.zeros(S, PROJ, dtype=bf, device="cuda")
+    health = torch.zeros(HEALTH_WORDS, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    flags = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    kda_pre(
+        key,
+        prefix=prefix,
+        delta=w["delta"],
+        blocks=blocks,
+        ares_nw=w["ares_nw"],
+        ares_qk=w["ares_qk"],
+        in_nw=w["in_nw"],
+        w_in=w["w_in"],
+        w_fb=w["w_fb"],
+        conv_w=w["conv_w"],
+        conv_state=conv_state,
+        a_log=w["a_log"],
+        dt_bias=w["dt_bias"],
+        on_w=w["on_w"],
+        rstate=rstate,
+        st_idx=w["st_idx"],
+        num_acc=w["num_acc"],
+        core_out=core,
+        scratch=torch.zeros(scratch_bytes(key), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda"),
+        layer=0,
+        epoch=torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        health=health,
+        alarm=flags.data_ptr(),
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert not health.any() and not flags.any()
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(prefix, ref["prefix"], atol=0, rtol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(blocks, ref["blocks"], atol=0, rtol=0)
+    # the conv output feeds the recurrence in fp32 here, bf16 in the reference
+    errs = {
+        "conv_state": _rel_l2(conv_state, ref["conv_state"]),
+        "rstate": _rel_l2(rstate, ref["rstate"]),
+        "core": _rel_l2(core, ref["core"]),
+    }
+    assert errs["conv_state"] < 1e-3 and errs["rstate"] < 1e-3, errs
+    assert _cos(core, ref["core"]) > COS_MIN, errs
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- K2 / MoE
+
+
+def _situ(g, u):
+    g, u = g.float(), u.float()
+    a = (2.0 * torch.tanh(g * 0.25)) * (1.0 + torch.tanh(g * 0.5))
+    return (a * (25.0 * torch.tanh(u * 0.04))).to(bf)
+
+
+def _all_reduce_fp32(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The ranks' bf16 partials summed in fp32, as vLLM's custom all-reduce."""
+    t = t.float()
+    dist.all_reduce(t)
+    return t.to(bf)
+
+
+def _moe_reference(x, mw, rank: int):
+    """KimiMoE's decode path on ``x``: sigmoid router + bias top-16, the latent
+    down, aiter's MXFP4 experts, the latent all-reduce + RMSNorm, this rank's
+    up_proj rows into the shared experts' output, the final all-reduce."""
+    from aiter import ActivationType, QuantType
+    from aiter.fused_moe import fused_moe
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono.stages.moe import SI, TOPK, UP_N
+
+    sig = torch.sigmoid(torch.mm(x.float(), mw["w_gate"].float().t()))
+    ids = torch.topk(sig + mw["bias"], TOPK, dim=-1, sorted=True).indices
+    wts = sig.gather(-1, ids)
+    wts = wts / wts.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+    gu = F.linear(x, mw["w_sgu"])
+    shared = F.linear(_situ(gu[:, :SI], gu[:, SI:]), mw["w_sd"])
+    y = fused_moe(
+        F.linear(x, mw["w_ld"]),
+        mw["w13"],
+        mw["w2"],
+        wts.float(),
+        ids.to(torch.int32),
+        None,
+        ActivationType.Situv2,
+        QuantType.per_1x32,
+        False,
+        mw["w13s"],
+        mw["w2s"],
+        None,
+        None,
+        dtype=bf,
+        gate_mode="separated",
+        beta=4.0,
+        linear_beta=25.0,
+    )
+    lat = _all_reduce_fp32(y).float()
+    ln = lat * torch.rsqrt(lat.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-5) * mw["ln_w"]
+    lo = rank * UP_N
+    up = ln.to(bf).float() @ mw["w_up_shard"].float().t()
+    shared[:, lo : lo + UP_N] = (shared[:, lo : lo + UP_N].float() + up).to(bf)
+    return _all_reduce_fp32(shared)
+
+
+def _moe_weights(rank: int, device):
+    from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
+
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono.stages.moe import HIDDEN, LAT, RI, SI, UP_N, E
+
+    gc = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(7)  # replicated weights
+    gr = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(100 + rank)  # TP shards
+
+    def u8(g, *shape, lo=0, hi=256):
+        return torch.randint(lo, hi, shape, generator=g, device=device).to(torch.uint8)
+
+    fp4, e8 = torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2, torch.float8_e8m0fnu
+    w_up = _randn(gc, HIDDEN, LAT, scale=0.02)
+    return {
+        "w_gate": _randn(gc, E, HIDDEN, scale=0.02),
+        "bias": _randn(gc, E, scale=0.02, dtype=torch.float32),
+        "w_ld": _randn(gc, LAT, HIDDEN, scale=0.02),
+        "ln_w": (1 + _randn(gc, LAT, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+        "w_up_shard": w_up[rank * UP_N : (rank + 1) * UP_N].contiguous(),
+        "w_sgu": _randn(gr, 2 * SI, HIDDEN, scale=0.02),
+        "w_sd": _randn(gr, HIDDEN, SI, scale=0.03),
+        "w13": rocm_aiter_ops.shuffle_weight_a16w4(
+            u8(gr, E, 2 * RI, LAT // 2).view(fp4), 16, False
+        ),
+        "w2": rocm_aiter_ops.shuffle_weight_a16w4(
+            u8(gr, E, LAT, RI // 2).view(fp4), 16, False
+        ),
+        "w13s": rocm_aiter_ops.shuffle_scale_a16w4(
+            u8(gr, E, 2 * RI, LAT // 32, lo=118, hi=123).view(e8).view(-1, LAT // 32),
+            E,
+            False,
+        ),
+        "w2s": e8m0_shuffle(
+            u8(gr, E, LAT, RI // 32, lo=118, hi=123).view(e8).view(-1, RI // 32)
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def _moe_args(mw):
+    return {
+        "w_gate": mw["w_gate"],
+        "bias": mw["bias"],
+        "w_ld": mw["w_ld"],
+        "w_sgu": mw["w_sgu"],
+        "w_sd": mw["w_sd"],
+        "w13": mw["w13"],
+        "w13s": mw["w13s"],
+        "w2": mw["w2"],
+        "w2s": mw["w2s"],
+        "ln_w": mw["ln_w"],
+        "w_up": mw["w_up_shard"],
+    }
+
+
+def _k2_inputs(rank: int, device):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono.attention.kda import HIDDEN, PROJ
+
+    gc = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(11)
+    gr = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(200 + rank)
+    return {
+        "core": _randn(gr, 8, PROJ),
+        "w_o": _randn(gr, HIDDEN, PROJ, scale=0.02),
+        "prefix": _randn(gc, 8, HIDDEN, scale=2.0),
+        "blocks": _randn(gc, 8, 8, HIDDEN, scale=2.0),
+        "ares_nw": (1 + _randn(gc, HIDDEN, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+        "ares_qk": _randn(gc, HIDDEN, scale=0.05),
+        "in_nw": (1 + _randn(gc, HIDDEN, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+    }
+
+
+def _k2_launch(runner, w, mw, prefix, out, reset: bool, nb: int = 4):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono import layer as k2
+
+    key = k2.K2Build(tokens=8, nblocks=nb + int(reset), reset=reset, **runner.fault)
+    k2.k2_launch(
+        key,
+        core=w["core"],
+        w_o=w["w_o"],
+        prefix=prefix,
+        blocks=w["blocks"],
+        ares_nw=w["ares_nw"],
+        ares_qk=w["ares_qk"],
+        in_nw=w["in_nw"],
+        out=out,
+        layer=3,
+        **_moe_args(mw),
+        **runner.launch_args(),
+        **runner.peer_args(),
+    )
+    return key
+
+
+def _init_worker(monkeypatch, tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port):

+    init_test_distributed_environment(tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port)

+
+@ray.remote(num_gpus=1, max_calls=1)

+        assert all(torch.equal(outs[0], o) for o in outs), "ranks disagree"
+
+    # A graph of one step (the epoch bump captured with it), replayed: a
+    # block-write launch writes its prefix, so every replay must match the first.
+    prefix = torch.empty_like(w["prefix"])
+    out = torch.empty(S, HIDDEN, dtype=bf, device=device)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        runner.step_begin()
+        _k2_launch(runner, w, mw, prefix, out, reset=True)
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    want_prefix, want_out = prefix.clone(), out.clone()
+    for _ in range(300):
+        graph.replay()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert torch.equal(prefix, want_prefix) and torch.equal(out, want_out)
+    assert not runner.health.any() and not runner.flags.any()
+

+STALLED = 3

+@ray.remote(num_gpus=1, max_calls=1)
+def _fault_worker(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    tp_size: int,
+    pp_size: int,
+    rank: int,
+    distributed_init_port: str,
+) -> None:

+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.runner import MonoRunner
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono import layer as k2
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono.attention.kda import HIDDEN
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono.common.debug import given_up_waits
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.mono.common.sync import WAIT_TICKS
+
+    runner = MonoRunner(device)
+    # rank STALLED's CTA 0 stalls past every wait's bound in the epoch 2 launch
+    runner.fault = {
+        "fault_rank": STALLED,
+        "fault_epoch": 2,
+        "fault_layer": 3,
+        "fault_ticks": WAIT_TICKS * 3 // 2,
+    }
+    mw = _moe_weights(rank, device)
+    w = _k2_inputs(rank, device)
+    out = torch.empty(8, HIDDEN, dtype=bf, device=device)
+    runner.step_begin()  # epoch 1: no stall

+    waits = given_up_waits(runner.health.cpu(), k2.REGIONS)
+    gave_up = torch.tensor([int(bool(waits))], device=device)
+    dist.all_reduce(gave_up)

+    if rank == 0:
+        assert runner.flags.any(), "the output rank's flags missed the failure"
+

+"""Which Kimi-K3 MoE calls take the mono MoE launch (CPU, no AITER needed).

+``MonoLatentMoE`` is bound to a stand-in runner; the kernel module is replaced

+

+

+
+
+class _Router:
+    top_k = 16
+    capture_fn = None
+
+
+class _Experts:
+    w13_weight = torch.empty(NE, 768, 1792, dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _stub(layer_ok=True):
+    r = types.SimpleNamespace(router=_Router(), routed_experts=_Experts())
+    s = mono_moe_decode.MonoLatentMoE(r)
+    s.__dict__["layer_ok"] = layer_ok
+    s.__dict__["shared_mlp_weights"] = (
+        torch.empty(1536, SH_HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        torch.empty(SH_HIDDEN, 768, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        4.0,
+        25.0,
+    )
+    return s
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def fake_runner(monkeypatch):
+    asked = []
+    mod = types.ModuleType(RUNNER)
+
+    def supported(x, ne, topk, inter, shared_x, w_gu, w_dn):
+        asked.append((x.shape[0], ne, topk, inter, tuple(w_dn.shape)))
+        return x.shape[0] <= 16
+
+    mod.supported = supported  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, RUNNER, mod)
+    return asked
+
+
+def _call(s, m, x_dtype=torch.bfloat16, logits_dtype=torch.float32, shared=True):
+    x = torch.empty(m, HIDDEN, dtype=x_dtype)
+    logits = torch.empty(m, NE, dtype=logits_dtype)
+    shared_x = torch.empty(m, SH_HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16) if shared else None
+    return s.eligible(x, logits, shared_x)

+    assert mono_moe_decode.MonoLatentMoE(types.SimpleNamespace()).layer_ok is False

+def test_small_decode_batches(fake_runner):
+    s = _stub()
+    assert _call(s, 1)
+    assert _call(s, 16)
+    assert not _call(s, 17)
+    assert [a[0] for a in fake_runner] == [1, 16, 17]
+    assert fake_runner[0][1:] == (NE, 16, 384, (SH_HIDDEN, 768))
+
+
+def test_declined(fake_runner):
+    assert not _call(_stub(), 4, shared=False)
+    assert not _call(_stub(), 4, x_dtype=torch.float16)
+    assert not _call(_stub(), 4, logits_dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    assert not _call(_stub(layer_ok=False), 4)
+    s = _stub()
+    s.r.router.capture_fn = lambda *a: None
+    assert not _call(s, 4)
+    assert fake_runner == []

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Kimi-K3 mono MoE launch (gfx950) against the kernels it replaces.
+
+One launch runs routing, the routed experts and the shared expert. Routed
+experts: AITER's ``biased_grouped_topk`` then ``fused_moe`` on the a4w4
+SiTUv2 path, with weights as vLLM's AITER_MXFP4_BF16 loader leaves them
+([gate; up] rows, ``shuffle_weight_a16w4`` / ``shuffle_scale_a16w4``). Shared
+expert: vLLM's KimiMLP math (bf16 gate_up GEMM, SiTU, bf16 down GEMM).
+
+Routing is drawn from a pool of experts (decode batches touch few distinct
+experts) or uniform (pool 0). The launch resets its own control words at exit,
+so it is also replayed from a CUDA graph, twice.
+"""
+
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+    pytest.skip("ROCm only", allow_module_level=True)
+
+from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950  # noqa: E402
+
+if not on_gfx950():
+    pytest.skip("the mono MoE launch is gfx950 only", allow_module_level=True)
+
+os.environ.setdefault("AITER_SITUV2_A4W4", "1")
+aiter = pytest.importorskip("aiter")
+pytest.importorskip("flydsl")
+
+from aiter import ActivationType, QuantType, dtypes, get_torch_quant  # noqa: E402
+from aiter.fused_moe import fused_moe  # noqa: E402
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.moe_common import GateMode  # noqa: E402
+from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_scale_a16w4, shuffle_weight_a16w4  # noqa: E402
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono_moe.runner import (  # noqa: E402
+    M_MAX,
+    mono_moe,
+    supported,
+)
+
+# Kimi-K3 at TP8: 896 experts, top-16, latent hidden 3584, 384 intermediate
+# columns a rank; the shared expert runs at the full hidden 7168, 768 columns.
+NE, TOPK, HIDDEN, INTER = 896, 16, 3584, 384
+SH_HIDDEN, SH_INTER = 7168, 768
+BETA, LINEAR_BETA = 4.0, 25.0
+SH_BETA, SH_LINEAR_BETA = 4.0, 25.0
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def weights():
+    torch.set_default_device("cuda")
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+    quant = get_torch_quant(QuantType.per_1x32)
+
+    def make(n, k, gate_up):
+        qs, ss = [], []
+        for e0 in range(0, NE, 64):
+            w = torch.randn((min(64, NE - e0), n, k), generator=g, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+            q, s = quant(w * 0.05, quant_dtype=dtypes.fp4x2)
+            qs.append(q.view(w.shape[0], n, k // 2))
+            ss.append(s.view(w.shape[0], n, k // 32))
+        q = shuffle_weight_a16w4(
+            torch.cat(qs).view(torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2), 16, gate_up
+        )
+        s = torch.cat(ss)
+        s = shuffle_scale_a16w4(s.view(-1, s.shape[-1]), NE, gate_up)
+        q.is_shuffled = True
+        return q, s
+
+    w1, w1s = make(2 * INTER, HIDDEN, True)
+    w2, w2s = make(HIDDEN, INTER, False)
+    w_gu = torch.randn(2 * SH_INTER, SH_HIDDEN, generator=g, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    w_dn = torch.randn(SH_HIDDEN, SH_INTER, generator=g, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    w_gu, w_dn = w_gu * 0.02, w_dn * 0.02
+    return w1, w2, w1s, w2s, w_gu, w_dn
+
+
+def make_inputs(m, pool, seed):
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    logits = torch.randn(m, NE, generator=g, device="cuda")
+    if 0 < pool < NE:
+        logits -= 8.0
+        logits[:, torch.randperm(NE, generator=g, device="cuda")[:pool]] += 16.0
+    x = torch.randn(m, HIDDEN, generator=g, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    sx = torch.randn(m, SH_HIDDEN, generator=g, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    bias = torch.randn(NE, generator=g, device="cuda") * 0.01
+    return logits, x, sx, bias
+
+
+def routed_reference(logits, bias, x, w1, w2, w1s, w2s):
+    m = x.shape[0]
+    tw = torch.empty(m, TOPK, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    ti = torch.empty(m, TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    aiter.biased_grouped_topk(logits, bias, tw, ti, 1, 1, True, 1.0)
+    out = fused_moe(
+        x, w1, w2, tw, ti,
+        quant_type=QuantType.per_1x32, activation=ActivationType.Situv2,
+        w1_scale=w1s, w2_scale=w2s, gate_mode=GateMode.SEPARATED.value,
+        swiglu_limit=0.0, beta=BETA, linear_beta=LINEAR_BETA,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    return out, tw, ti
+
+
+def shared_reference(x, w_gu, w_dn):
+    gu = (x @ w_gu.t()).float()
+    d = gu.shape[-1] // 2
+    gate = SH_BETA * torch.tanh(gu[:, :d] / SH_BETA) * torch.sigmoid(gu[:, :d])
+    up = SH_LINEAR_BETA * torch.tanh(gu[:, d:] / SH_LINEAR_BETA)
+    return (gate * up).to(x.dtype) @ w_dn.t()
+
+
+def graph_of(fn):
+    s = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    s.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(s):
+        for _ in range(3):
+            fn()
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(s)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    g = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(g):
+        fn()
+    return g
+
+
+def cos_min(a, b):
+    return (
+        torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(a.float(), b.float(), dim=1).min().item()
+    )
+
+
+def test_supported_sizes(weights):
+    w1, _, _, _, w_gu, w_dn = weights
+    for m in (1, M_MAX, M_MAX + 1):
+        x = torch.empty(m, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        sx = torch.empty(m, SH_HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        assert supported(x, NE, TOPK, INTER, sx, w_gu, w_dn) == (m <= M_MAX)
+    assert not supported(x, NE, TOPK, INTER, x, w_gu, w_dn)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("pool", [64, 0])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("m", [1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 13, 16, 17, 24, 31, 32])
+def test_mono_moe(weights, m, pool):
+    w1, w2, w1s, w2s, w_gu, w_dn = weights
+    logits, x, sx, bias = make_inputs(m, pool, seed=100 + m)
+    ref, ref_w, ref_i = routed_reference(logits, bias, x, w1, w2, w1s, w2s)
+    sh_ref = shared_reference(sx, w_gu, w_dn)
+
+    tw = torch.empty(m, TOPK, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    ti = torch.empty(m, TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    out = torch.empty(m, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    sh_out = torch.empty(m, SH_HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")

+decoder layer's decode step in a single launch. A model brings a ``MonoSpec``
+(``spec``); this package owns the rest: refusals (``guards``), the per-step
+decision and cache re-binding (``routing``), the layer-loop hook (``layer``),
+fail-stop and metrics (``failstop``), peer memory (``peer``) and the

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The layout every MonoKernel's error words follow.
+
+A rank's health words: a header whose word FAILED is set once any of its
+in-kernel waits gave up (sticky: a failed rank stays failed, and its later waits
+exit at once), then one record a CTA of the first wait it gave up on (flag,
+region id, pair index, tag, seen tag, CTA, clock, pad).
+
+The output rank's flags: one int32 word a TP rank in the first PEER_HEAD bytes
+of the output rank's peer buffer. A rank whose wait gives up writes its word
+there, drains the store, then sets FAILED, so nothing it stores later can
+overtake the flag. The runner reads these words after every step.
+"""
+
+MONO_ABI_VERSION = 1
+
+RECORD_WORDS = 8
+FAILED = 0
+PEER_HEAD = 256  # bytes: the output rank's flags, a word a rank
+WAIT_SECONDS = 10  # an in-kernel wait gives up after this long
+
+
+def health_words(ctas: int) -> int:
+    """A rank's health words for a grid of ``ctas``: the header, a record a CTA."""
+    return (ctas + 1) * RECORD_WORDS

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Fail-stop and metrics.
+
+A MonoKernel never returns tokens from a step it did not finish: the runner
+copies the model's error words (``abi``) next to the sampled token ids, and
+``check`` raises before that step's tokens are returned. The engine then stops
+like on any other engine death, and the deployment's restart policy recovers
+it.
+
+Counters (``drain``, exported as ``vllm:monokernel_steps`` and
+``vllm:monokernel_incidents``): steps on the kernels, steps on vLLM's path by
+reason, and incidents by failed rank.
+"""
+
+from collections import Counter
+
+import torch
+
+STEPS: Counter[tuple[str, str]] = Counter()  # (spec, "mono" or the no-go reason)
+INCIDENTS: Counter[str] = Counter()  # by failed TP rank
+
+
+def count_step(spec: str, why: str | None) -> None:
+    STEPS[spec, why or "mono"] += 1
+
+
+def drain() -> dict[str, int] | None:
+    """The counts since the last drain: ``"steps:<spec>:<path>"`` (path "mono"
+    or the reason the step ran vLLM's layers) and ``"incidents:<rank>"``."""
+    if not STEPS and not INCIDENTS:
+        return None
+    out = {f"steps:{spec}:{path}": n for (spec, path), n in STEPS.items()}
+    out.update({f"incidents:{rank}": n for rank, n in INCIDENTS.items()})
+    STEPS.clear()
+    INCIDENTS.clear()
+    return out
+
+
+def check(words: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """``words``: the output rank's error words for one step, on the host (a
+    word a TP rank, nonzero once one of its in-kernel waits gave up)."""
+    if not words.any():
+        return
+    ranks = [r for r, w in enumerate(words.tolist()) if w]
+    for r in ranks:
+        INCIDENTS[str(r)] += 1
+    msg = (
+        f"MonoKernel step failed: TP ranks {ranks} gave up an in-kernel wait; "
+        "the step's tokens are discarded"
+    )
+    raise RuntimeError(msg)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Refusals. ``configure`` runs once from core config post-init, before load:
+it imports only the model's spec, adds the widths to the CUDA graph capture
+sizes and raises with every reason the config is refused. ``agree`` runs a
+later refusal stage (after load) on every TP rank and agrees on the verdict
+before anything collective follows."""
+
+import importlib
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.models.common.mono.spec import Feature, MonoSpec, MonoUnsupported
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def enabled(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> bool:
+    """``--monokernel``."""
+    return vllm_config.kernel_config.monokernel
+
+
+def load_spec(path: str) -> MonoSpec:
+    """``"package.module:NAME"`` -> the spec, importing only that module."""
+    module, name = path.split(":")
+    return getattr(importlib.import_module(module), name)
+
+
+def features_in_use(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> set[Feature]:
+    pc = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    oc = vllm_config.offload_config
+    on = {
+        Feature.PIPELINE_PARALLEL: pc.pipeline_parallel_size > 1,
+        Feature.DATA_PARALLEL: pc.data_parallel_size > 1,
+        Feature.EXPERT_PARALLEL: pc.enable_expert_parallel,
+        Feature.EPLB: pc.enable_eplb,
+        Feature.DECODE_CONTEXT_PARALLEL: pc.decode_context_parallel_size > 1,
+        Feature.PREFILL_CONTEXT_PARALLEL: pc.prefill_context_parallel_size > 1,
+        Feature.LORA: vllm_config.lora_config is not None,
+        Feature.KV_CONNECTOR: vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None,
+        Feature.ROUTED_EXPERT_CAPTURE: (
+            vllm_config.aux_output_config.enable_return_routed_experts
+        ),
+        Feature.SPECULATIVE_DECODING: vllm_config.speculative_config is not None,
+        Feature.SLEEP_MODE: vllm_config.model_config.enable_sleep_mode,
+        Feature.CPU_WEIGHT_OFFLOAD: (
+            oc.uva.cpu_offload_gb > 0 or oc.prefetch.offload_group_size > 0
+        ),
+        Feature.WEIGHT_UPDATES: vllm_config.weight_transfer_config is not None,
+    }
+    return {f for f, used in on.items() if used}
+
+
+def refuse_config(spec: MonoSpec, vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> list[str]:
+    """Default-deny, the runner and the graph mode, then the spec's own."""
+    reasons = [
+        f"{f.value} is not supported"
+        for f in sorted(features_in_use(vllm_config) - spec.supports)
+    ]
+    if not vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner:
+        reasons.append("needs Model Runner V2")
+    mode = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode
+    if mode is not None and mode not in (
+        CUDAGraphMode.NONE,
+        CUDAGraphMode.FULL,
+        CUDAGraphMode.FULL_DECODE_ONLY,
+        CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE,
+    ):
+        # PIECEWISE captures carry no attention metadata
+        reasons.append(f"CUDA graph mode {mode.name}: decode needs FULL graphs")
+    return reasons + spec.refuse_config(vllm_config)
+
+
+def capture_sizes(
+    spec_path: str, vllm_config: "VllmConfig", sizes: list[int]
+) -> list[int]:
+    """``sizes`` (vLLM's final capture sizes) with those up to the largest width
+    replaced by exactly the widths, so a replay never pads a request's rows;
+    larger sizes stay (and capture vLLM's path)."""
+    spec = load_spec(spec_path)
+    widths = spec.widths(vllm_config)
+    new = sorted(set(widths) | {s for s in sizes if s > max(widths)})
+    if new != sorted(sizes):
+        logger.info("MonoKernel %s: CUDA graph capture sizes %s", spec.name, new)
+    return new
+
+
+def configure(vllm_config: "VllmConfig", spec_path: str) -> None:
+    spec = load_spec(spec_path)
+    reasons = refuse_config(spec, vllm_config)
+    if reasons:
+        raise MonoUnsupported(f"MonoKernel {spec.name} refused: " + "; ".join(reasons))
+    if vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.NONE:
+        logger.warning(
+            "MonoKernel %s under eager mode: for debugging only, serve with FULL "
+            "CUDA graphs",
+            spec.name,
+        )
+
+
+def agree(refuse: Callable[[], list[str]], group, what: str) -> None:
+    """``refuse``'s reasons on this rank, then every TP rank's verdict agreed: a
+    rank that refused alone would leave the others spinning in-kernel."""
+    reasons = refuse()
+    flag = torch.tensor([int(not reasons)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    torch.distributed.all_reduce(flag, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group)
+    if reasons:
+        raise MonoUnsupported(f"{what}: " + "; ".join(reasons))
+    if not flag.item():
+        raise MonoUnsupported(f"{what}: another TP rank refused")

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The hooks a model calls: ``attach`` after load, ``forward_layer`` in its
+layer loop, ``health`` from ``step_health``."""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.models.common.mono import failstop
+from vllm.models.common.mono.guards import enabled, load_spec
+from vllm.models.common.mono.routing import Mono
+
+_ATTACHED: Mono | None = None  # this process's, for the runner's accounting
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+
+
+def attach(model, vllm_config: "VllmConfig", spec_path: str) -> Mono | None:
+    """Packs weights and builds this rank's layer kernels; None with the switch
+    off. Collective over the TP group."""
+    global _ATTACHED
+    if not enabled(vllm_config):
+        return None
+    _ATTACHED = Mono(load_spec(spec_path), model, vllm_config)
+    return _ATTACHED
+
+
+def begin_step(mono: Mono, positions: torch.Tensor) -> str | None:
+    return mono.begin_step(positions)
+
+
+def forward_layer(mono: Mono | None, i: int, layer, positions, *args, **kwargs):
+    """Layer ``i`` on its kernel when this step runs on the kernels, else the
+    vLLM layer unchanged. The first call under a forward context decides for
+    every layer (``begin_step``)."""
+    if mono is not None:
+        fc = get_forward_context()
+        if fc is not mono._fc:
+            mono._fc = fc
+            begin_step(mono, positions)
+        step = mono.step
+        if step is not None and (k := mono.kernels.get((i, step.width))) is not None:
+            return k.launch(step, positions, *args, **kwargs)
+    return layer(positions, *args, **kwargs)
+
+
+def health(mono: Mono | None) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """The step's error words, read by the runner after each step: any set
+    word fails the step before its tokens are returned (``failstop``)."""
+    return None if mono is None else mono.health()
+
+
+def account_step(num_tokens: int, runtime_mode: CUDAGraphMode) -> dict[str, int] | None:
+    """Called by the runner after every served step: counts it, and returns the
+    counters to export since the last call (``failstop.drain``)."""
+    if _ATTACHED is None:
+        return None
+    _ATTACHED.account(num_tokens, runtime_mode)
+    return failstop.drain()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# Adapted from ROCm/ATOM (https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM) at a526f0d, MIT License,
+# Copyright (C) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.:
+# atom/mono/runtime/peer_memory.py
+# atom/mono/runtime/consensus.py
+"""Peer memory for in-kernel TP collectives: one uncached buffer a rank, every
+rank holding every peer's address, and the TP agreements that must precede
+anything collective."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.models.common.mono.spec import MonoUnsupported
+
+
+class _DeviceBytes:
+    """``__cuda_array_interface__`` of ``nbytes`` bytes at a raw device address, for a
+    non-owning torch view."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ptr: int, nbytes: int):
+        self.__cuda_array_interface__ = {
+            "shape": (nbytes,),
+            "typestr": "|u1",
+            "data": (ptr, False),
+            "version": 3,
+        }
+
+
+class PeerBuffer:
+    """One uncached buffer per rank, every rank holding every peer's address
+    (``addresses``, int64, indexed by TP rank). What lives where, and why no rank
+    overwrites a peer's unread data, is the model's layout's to say.
+
+    ``bytes`` is the whole buffer: the kernels tag every pair with the step's
+    epoch, so it is never zeroed between steps.
+
+    The constructor is collective over ``group`` (the handle exchange, then an
+    agreement that every rank mapped every peer): every rank must reach it, so a
+    runner reaches it only after ``tp_agree``. A failed mapping on any rank raises
+    ``MonoUnsupported`` on all of them.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        nbytes: int,
+        group,
+        rank: int,
+        npes: int,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ):
+        from aiter.ops.flydsl.quick_allreduce_int4_ipc import UncachedIpcHeap
+
+        self._heap = UncachedIpcHeap
+        self.local = UncachedIpcHeap.alloc_uncached(nbytes)
+        # a view, not an owner: close() frees the memory under it
+        self.bytes = torch.as_tensor(_DeviceBytes(self.local, nbytes), device=device)
+        self.rank = rank
+        self._opened: list[int] = []
+        addresses = [self.local]
+        if npes > 1:
+            handles = UncachedIpcHeap.gather_object_list_via_broadcast(
+                group, UncachedIpcHeap.get_mem_handle_bytes(self.local)
+            )
+            addresses, failure = [], None
+            try:
+                for peer, handle in enumerate(handles):
+                    if peer == rank:
+                        addresses.append(self.local)
+                    else:
+                        base = UncachedIpcHeap.open_mem_handle(handle)
+                        self._opened.append(base)
+                        addresses.append(base)
+            except RuntimeError as err:  # every rank must still reach the agreement
+                failure = err
+            if not tp_agree(failure is None, group):
+                self.close()
+                raise MonoUnsupported(
+                    "peer memory handshake failed on "
+                    f"{'this' if failure else 'another'}"
+                    " TP rank"
+                ) from failure
+        self.addresses = torch.tensor(addresses, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Close the peer mappings and free the local buffer; idempotent. Only once no
+        kernel of any rank can still touch it (the runner is being dropped)."""
+        opened, self._opened = self._opened, []
+        for base in opened:
+            self._heap.close_mem_handle(base)
+        if self.local:
+            self.bytes = None
+            self._heap.free_device_mem(self.local)
+            self.local = 0
+
+
+# Decisions every TP rank must take alike.
+#
+# A mono kernel waits in-kernel on every peer rank, so a rank that turned mono off
+# alone -- or failed to build what the others launch -- leaves the others spinning
+# on the GPU for ever. Each such decision is a local verdict agreed on over the TP
+# group's CPU group before anything collective (peer handshake, launch) follows.
+#
+
+
+def tp_agree(ok: bool, group) -> bool:
+    """True when every rank of ``group`` passed ``ok`` true. Every rank must call
+    it at the same point; ``group`` is a CPU (gloo) process group, or None for a
+    single rank."""
+    if group is None:
+        return ok
+    flag = torch.tensor([int(ok)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    dist.all_reduce(flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group)
+    return bool(flag.item())
+
+
+def bind_agreed(bind, group) -> None:
+    """``bind()`` on this rank (raising ``MonoUnsupported`` to refuse), then every
+    rank's verdict agreed: a rank that raised re-raises, the others raise too."""
+    try:
+        bind()
+    except Exception:
+        tp_agree(False, group)
+        raise
+    if not tp_agree(True, group):
+        raise MonoUnsupported("another TP rank refused mono")

+"""The per-step decision and cache re-binding.
+
+``Mono.begin_step`` decides once a forward, for every kernel layer, from what
+every rank sees alike: the batch's width and the attention metadata, never
+rank-local state. Under a FULL CUDA graph the decision is baked in at capture,
+so it is a function of the captured size: FULL graphs serve uniform decode
+batches and every width is a capture size (``guards.capture_sizes``), so
+no replay pads a request's rows. PIECEWISE steps run vLLM's layers.

+

+    class CompileKey:

+        build: Any  # a hashable build key its LayerKernel compiles
+
+    def __init__(self, spec: str, owners: dict[Any, LayerKernel]):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.spec = spec
+        self.owners = owners
+
+    def get_warmup_keys(self) -> list["MonoWarmup.CompileKey"]:
+        return [self.CompileKey(self.spec, b) for b in self.owners]
+
+    def compile(self, compile_key: "MonoWarmup.CompileKey") -> None:
+        self.owners[compile_key.build].compile(compile_key.build)
+        self._compiled_cache[compile_key] = True
+

+class Mono:
+    """A model's MonoKernels on this rank: built once after load."""
+
+    def __init__(self, spec: MonoSpec, model, vllm_config: "VllmConfig"):
+        from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group

+        tp = get_tp_group()
+        self.spec = spec
+        agree(
+            lambda: spec.refuse_model(model),
+            tp.cpu_group,
+            f"MonoKernel {spec.name} refused for the loaded model",
+        )
+        self.ctx = MonoContext(
+            vllm_config, tp.rank_in_group, next(model.parameters()).device
+        )
+        packed = spec.pack(model, self.ctx)
+        self.widths = spec.widths(vllm_config)
+        self.kernels: dict[tuple[int, int], LayerKernel] = {}
+        for i in spec.layers(model.config):
+            # PPMissingLayer and other ranks' layers never get a kernel
+            if model.start_layer <= i < model.end_layer:
+                for w in self.widths:
+                    self.kernels[i, w] = spec.build(
+                        self.ctx, packed, model.layers[i], w
+                    )
+        self.cache_layers = sorted(
+            {n for k in self.kernels.values() for n in k.cache_layers}
+        )
+        self._register_warmup()
+        self.step: MonoStep | None = None
+        # the decision each captured FULL graph baked in, by size: a replay
+        # runs no Python, so a step is counted from its size (``account``)
+        self.baked: dict[int, str | None] = {}
+        self.last: str | None = "no step"
+        self._fc: Any = None
+        self._bound: tuple | None = None
+        logger.info(
+            "MonoKernel %s: %d layers, widths %s",
+            spec.name,
+            len({i for i, _ in self.kernels}),
+            list(self.widths),
+        )
+
+    def _register_warmup(self) -> None:
+        """Every width's builds compile in vLLM's JIT warm-up, before capture."""
+        owners: dict[Any, LayerKernel] = {}
+        for k in self.kernels.values():
+            for key in k.warmup_keys():
+                owners.setdefault(key, k)
+        if owners:
+            MonoWarmup(self.spec.name, owners).register_warmup()
+
+    def _bind(self) -> None:
+        """Re-checks the caches whenever they moved (keyed on every tensor's
+        data_ptr and numel): memory profiling runs real steps on throwaway
+        caches before the real ones exist."""
+        sfc = self.ctx.vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+        caches = {n: sfc[n].kv_cache for n in self.cache_layers}
+        key = tuple(
+            (t.data_ptr(), t.numel())
+            for c in caches.values()
+            for t in (c if isinstance(c, (list, tuple)) else (c,))
+        )
+        if key == self._bound:
+            return
+        reasons = self.spec.bind(self.ctx, caches)
+        if reasons:
+            raise MonoUnsupported(
+                f"MonoKernel {self.spec.name} caches: " + "; ".join(reasons)
+            )
+        self._bound = key
+
+    def begin_step(self, positions: torch.Tensor) -> str | None:
+        """None runs this step on the kernels (and sets ``step``), else the
+        reason it runs vLLM's layers."""
+        self.step = None
+        why = self._decide(positions)
+        # Model Runner V2 captures with the runtime mode NONE
+        if (
+            get_forward_context().cudagraph_runtime_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+            or torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+        ):
+            self.baked[positions.size(-1)] = why
+        self.last = why
+        return why
+
+    def account(self, num_tokens: int, runtime_mode: CUDAGraphMode) -> None:
+        """Counts one served step, after its forward."""
+        if runtime_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL:
+            why = self.baked.get(num_tokens, "not captured")
+        else:
+            why, self.last = self.last, "no step"
+        failstop.count_step(self.spec.name, why)
+
+    def _decide(self, positions: torch.Tensor) -> str | None:
+        fc = get_forward_context()
+        if fc.cudagraph_runtime_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE:
+            return "piecewise"
+        n = positions.size(-1)
+        if n not in self.widths:
+            return "width"
+        step = MonoStep(n, n, positions, fc.attn_metadata, fc.cudagraph_runtime_mode)
+        why = self.spec.eligible(self.ctx, step)
+        if why is None:
+            self._bind()
+            self.step = step
+        return why
+
+    def health(self) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return next(iter(self.kernels.values())).health()

+# Kimi-K3 mono decode (MI355X)
+
+A MonoKernel as RFC #60904 proposes, opt-in with `--monokernel`. A pure
+spec-verify step of at most 8 rows runs each MoE decoder layer as persistent
+FlyDSL launches (256 CTAs, all resident), the TP all-reduces in-kernel over
+peer memory:
+
+- **Whole layers** (KDA): K1 (AttnRes, in_proj, f_b, spec conv, KDA recurrence,
+  gated RMSNorm), then K2.
+- **FFN layers** (MLA): vLLM's AttnRes and MLA up to o_proj's input, then K2.
+- **K2**: o_proj + all-reduce + MLP AttnRes, then the latent MoE (router,
+  top-16, MXFP4 experts, shared experts, latent all-reduce + RMSNorm, up_proj,
+  final all-reduce).
+
+```text
+mono/
+    spec.py      MONO_SPEC: layers, widths, supports, refusals, pack, bind,
+                 eligible, build
+    kernel.py    the layer kernels: vLLM tensors -> launches
+    runner.py    per-rank launch state: scratch, step epoch, health, peers
+    runtime.py   model-agnostic: configure, attach, forward_layer, health
+                 (private until vllm/models/common/mono/ exists)
+ops/mono/        kernel source
+    layer.py     K2
+    attention/   kda.py (K1), back.py
+    stages/      moe.py, gemv.py
+    common/      device ops, mailbox sync, MX helpers, plan / build keys,
+                 peer memory (adapted from ROCm/ATOM atom/mono, MIT)
+```
+
+With the switch on, an unsupported config raises at startup with every reason.
+Every other step (prefill, mixed, other widths, PIECEWISE graphs) runs vLLM's
+layers.
+
+Every in-kernel wait gives up after 10 s: the rank records the wait, raises its
+flag on the output rank and stops waiting. `step_health()` returns the output
+rank's flags; Model Runner V2 fails the step before its tokens are returned.
+`tests/models/kimi_k3/amd_mono/test_engine_fault.py` stalls a rank in a served
+model and checks the engine stops.
